mainEntity.name: What is the purity range of Moroccan copper supplied by The 3 Rocks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our Moroccan copper ore typically ranges from 8% to 21% purity. We also offer high-purity copper of up to 40% under special export permit.

mainEntity.name: What are the industrial applications of your Moroccan copper?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is widely used in electrical wiring, telecommunications infrastructure, heat exchangers, cooling systems, and electronics manufacturing.
